name: Kryptos
tagline: Encrypt your messages right inside any chat app
description:
Kryptos lets you encrypt messages without ever leaving the messaging app you're already using. It works as a keyboard: type your message, it encrypts it, and the other person's screen decrypts it back, so there's no separate app to jump into.

It uses the Signal Protocol for strong end-to-end encryption and works completely offline. Kryptos is available for both Android and iOS.
